turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Hi there, how are you feeling now after the surgery?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: Meh, still a bit tired lah, but okay. Got some pain here, but the nurse gave me medicine already.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Can you tell me your pain level on a scale of 1 to 10? And have you felt any nausea or vomiting?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: Pain maybe 4 or 5, not too bad. Stomach also got little bit upset, but not throwing up. Just feel like want to sleep more.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Any trouble breathing or coughing? Your airway was managed with a tube during surgery.

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: Throat sore a bit, like something stuck there, but breathing okay lah. Not short of breath.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Do you remember anything from the operation? Any dreams or awareness during surgery?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: Nope, all black out. Woke up only when nurse called my name here.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Your blood pressure and sugar levels were monitored. Any concerns about your diabetes or cholesterol?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: Blood pressure machine beeping whole time, but nurse say stable. Sugar also checked, not too high. Cholesterol... mmm, still taking pills right?

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: All your medications will continue as usual. Let the nurse know if pain or nausea gets worse, okay?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: Yes, thank you. Just want to rest now and go home soon lah.
